name: Charts Plotly API Example
description: Demonstrates how to use the Charts API with the Plotly.js library.
project_description: Charts Plotly API Example is a submodule of Charts Plotly that demonstrates the Charts render API rendered with Plotly.js. It adds a single page at /charts/example/plotly that builds the shared library-agnostic example gallery (from charts_api_example's ChartExampleBuilder) for the 'plotly' library and appends Plotly-specific demonstrations: radar (scatterpolar), candlestick (OHLC), boxplot (from raw observations) and heatmap (series aggregated into a Z-matrix). It is a reference/example module only and should not be enabled on production sites.
